title: Reproducible runtime and dependency baseline
goal: Make clean installation, dependency security, type checking, and production builds deterministic on the supported production runtime

in: Node and npm runtime contracts across local, CI, Docker, and Vercel
Dependency graph, patched Next.js release, clean installation, type checking, and production build
out: Feature implementation unrelated to build or dependency readiness

acceptance_criteria: Node 24.x and the pinned npm version are consistent across local, CI, Docker, and Vercel
npm ci succeeds without legacy peer-dependency bypasses
Next.js is on a patched supported release and no unaccepted critical/high production vulnerability remains
Type checking and production build complete deterministically from a fresh checkout

evidence: Audit baseline: local Node 24 conflicts with the repository Node 20 contract; Vercel warned Node 20 support ends for new deployments after 2026-10-01.
Audit baseline: npm ci peer resolution fails, installed Next.js 15.5.15 has reported security advisories, and the production build compiled but did not complete type validation in the bounded run.
check:toolchain passed on Node v24.19.0 with npm 11.17.0 and lockfile v3.

An isolated manifest fixture using Node v24.19.0 and npm 11.17.0 completed unflagged npm ci, including the repository preinstall toolchain check and Prisma postinstall, without a legacy peer-dependency bypass.
npm run check:peer-deps passed, and npm audit --audit-level=high exited 0 with 0 high and 0 critical findings; a fresh fixture reported 34 remaining low/moderate findings.
Next.js 15.5.24 is the current patched Maintenance LTS release in the official August 2026 security release.
npm run typecheck was interrupted after approximately six minutes with no diagnostics or completion; no pass or compiler failure is claimed.
npm run build:vercel stopped at the production environment guard because the configured NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is not an absolute HTTPS URL; compilation did not begin and the guard was not bypassed.

2026-09-19: The production build environment contract passes when run with an approved HTTPS origin (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://tourify.live); the guard is a configuration gate, not a code defect, and the approved deployment env files (deployment/demo.env, deployment/production.env) already carry HTTPS origins.

2026-09-19: npm run build:vercel with the approved HTTPS origin began compilation on Next.js 15.5.24 and reached the type-checking build stage, but did not complete within a bounded 30-minute run in the dirty shared worktree; consistent with the known slow full-typecheck constraint.

2026-09-19: npm run check:migration-validation passed for the full migration chain including the newest MFA verification-code store migration; migration checksums and supabase-target checks remain hosted/credential-gated because they require MIGRATION_CHECKSUM_BASE_SHA, SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID, and SUPABASE_TARGET_CONFIRMATION inputs that are not present in this workspace.
npm run agents:validate passed with 17 agents, 109 tasks, 0 warnings, and 0 errors.

2026-09-20 (curated checkout 59971a9e): Definitive npm run build:vercel run to completion with the approved origin (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://tourify.live) exited 1 at the production environment guard before compilation. Exact first error chain: build:vercel -> validate:env:production (node --import tsx scripts/ci/validate-production-env.ts --phase build) -> validateProductionEnvironment("build") in lib/config/environment-contract.ts -> issue code "missing" with variables NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ENCRYPTION_KEY, INTERNAL_API_SECRET, CRON_SECRET. The clean checkout carries no .env* files (.env* gitignored at .gitignore:24), so the six required production variables are absent; .next/BUILD_ID was not produced, and the 04:00Z 2026-09-20 temp-worktree compile claim is unverifiable because that worktree (and its evidence) was swept.
